description: The principal. Handles session identity and continuity — who the caller is, what state belongs to them, and which prior commitments are theirs. Distinct from MEMORY-µ, which stores session context as committed memory: this track decides whose context it is and whether a caller may act on it.

folds.note: identity conditions the request; it does not yet authorize it
which committed state belongs to this principal
a caller may not act under another principal's session
